svg.desc: Chart kit: components/charts and who renders it. 19 components in 3 groups. Connections: StandardRadarChart to RadarChart (renders); Bespoke analytics charts to CartesianChart (renders); Standard x/y wrappers to CartesianChart (renders); Standard x/y wrappers to ChartBrush (zoom); StandardPieChart to PieChart (renders); CategoryTreemap to Treemap (renders); Page x/y charts to CartesianChart (renders); Page x/y charts to ChartBrush (zoom); Cash Flow page to SankeyDiagram (renders); Comparison page to SlopeChart (renders); Page pies to PieChart (renders); RadarChart to ChartFrame; CartesianChart to ChartFrame (wraps in); CartesianChart to CartesianChart children (scales via context); PieChart to ChartFrame; Treemap to ChartFrame; SankeyDiagram to ChartFrame; SlopeChart to ChartFrame; Chart kit (components/charts) to Motion 14 (animates with).

text.tspan: CHART KIT: COMPONENTS/CHARTS AND WHO RENDERS IT
In-house animated SVG charts that replaced Recharts; every chart root draws inside ChartFrame and animates with Motion 14
